findings.evidence: The score starts at 100 and loses 30 for any TODO left, 10 per missing or incomplete required section, 20 for any secret, 5 per missing referenced file (max 20) and 2 per missing recommended section
findings.fix: Add one sentence after that list: a secret forces BLOCKED even when the arithmetic is 70 or more, and one incomplete required section forces NEEDS_WORK even when the arithmetic is 90, so report the verdict, not the number alone.
